description: Coastal Blue Carbon in Practice is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Restore America's Estuaries; Silvestrum Climate Associates. Coastal blue carbon ecosystems are significant carbon sinks. They present new opportunities for carbon finance to benefit wetland habitat restoration and conservation efforts. Blue carbon intervention refers to the ability of coastal wetland ecosystems (mangroves, tidal marshes, and seagrasses) to sequester and store carbon dioxide. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
